question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is '**faced**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the actions taken during forest fires.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate an action that is commonly taken when dealing with forest fires.
 
• "**Faced**" fits well as it denotes confronting or dealing with a situation, which aligns with the context of forest fires.
 
• Other options ("**surrendered**", "**accepted**", "**casted**") do not fit the context of describing actions taken during forest fires.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Surrendered (समर्पित):** "Surrendered" means to give up, which does not fit the context of discussing actions taken during forest fires.
 
• **Accepted (स्वीकार किया):** "Accepted" means to consent to receive, which does not reflect the idea of dealing with forest fires.
 
• **Casted (डाला गया): **"Casted" means to throw something forcefully, which does not align with describing actions taken during forest fires.
